subject: CS481
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 2 Arabic videos. English coverage is strong across all topics, with high-quality, relevant explainers. Arabic coverage is sparse; suitable videos were found for only two topics (FIPs/Privacy Act and National ID risks). For the other three Arabic topics, all candidates were either irrelevant (e.g., technical data mining tutorials instead of ethics, general financial advice instead of specific laws) or failed hard gates.

coverage.topic: Government Data Mining and Mass Surveillance
Government Data Mining and Mass Surveillance

coverage.topic: Credit and Financial Privacy Regulations (FCRA & GLBA)
Credit and Financial Privacy Regulations (FCRA & GLBA)

Privacy Risks of National ID and SSN

A highly relevant candidate [122] failed view count and duration gates. Selected video is the best available explainer on FOIA.
No candidates discuss Freedom of Information laws; they are about general digital/human rights and fail the relevance gate.
